meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审慎处理代码审查反馈，验证后再实施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查意见时想先验证再修改
copy.tagline_en: Handle code review feedback with verification before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify code review feedback before implementing changes

howto.what: 收到代码审查反馈后，先完整阅读，再理解并核实，最后才实施修改。避免表演性同意，优先技术正确性。
howto.when: 当收到代码审查反馈，尤其是反馈不清晰或技术上可疑时触发。

say.text: 我理解了第1、2、3、6项，但第4和第5项需要澄清。
say.note: 先澄清所有不明确项，避免部分理解导致错误实施。

say.text: 检查代码库后，这个API未被调用，是否应该移除（YAGNI）？
say.note: 对建议的“专业功能”进行YAGNI检查，避免添加无用功能。

say.text: 你之前决定用旧API保持兼容，这个建议会破坏它。
say.note: 当外部建议与人类伙伴的先前决策冲突时，先讨论。

howto.what_en: After receiving code review feedback, read it fully, then understand and verify before implementing. Avoid performative agreement; prioritize technical correctness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when receiving code review feedback, especially if unclear or technically questionable.

say_en.text: I understand items 1,2,3,6 but need clarification on 4 and 5.
say_en.note: Clarify unclear items first to avoid partial implementation.

say_en.text: Grepped codebase - this endpoint isn't called. Remove it (YAGNI)?
say_en.note: Perform YAGNI check on suggested 'professional' features.

say_en.text: Your prior decision uses legacy API for compatibility; this suggestion would break it.
